description: Find and book appointments at local businesses — nail salons, hair salons, spas, restaurants and more — right from the chat. Tell Hey Book what you're looking for and where, pick a business, share your name, date, and time, and your request goes straight to them. They'll reply to confirm.

defaultPrompt: Find me a hair salon in Singapore I can book right now
Book me a hair salon appointment tomorrow afternoon
Are there any hair salons near Orchard I can book through Hey Book?
interface.longDescription: Find and book appointments at local businesses — nail salons, hair salons, spas, restaurants and more — right from the chat. Tell Hey Book what you're looking for and where, pick a business, share your name, date, and time, and your request goes straight to them. They'll reply to confirm.

name: hey-book

positive.description: Basic search by business type and area should call search_businesses with a fuzzy query.
positive.prompt: Find me a nail salon in Orchard, Singapore
positive.expected_behavior: search_businesses is called with a query containing terms like "nail" and "salon". The tool returns a JSON list of businesses of type "nail_salon". The model presents them to the user with their id, name, and address.

positive.description: Search should also work for hair salons, not just nail salons.
positive.prompt: Are there any hair salons on Hey Book?
positive.expected_behavior: search_businesses is called with a query containing terms like "hair" and "salon". The tool returns businesses of type "salon". The model lists the matching salon(s) to the user.

positive.description: End-to-end booking flow: search for a business, then book with the required fields. Email is not collected from the user — it comes from their signed-in Hey Book account.
positive.prompt: Book me a nail appointment tomorrow at 2pm for 1 person, my name is Sarah Tan
positive.expected_behavior: search_businesses is called first to find a nail salon; the model presents the top match and asks the user to confirm. Once confirmed, make_booking is called with the chosen business_id, customer_name "Sarah Tan", the resolved date for "tomorrow", time "14:00", and party_size 1 — no email argument is passed. The server derives the customer's email from their authenticated Hey Book sign-in and returns { success: true, booking_id, status: "pending", message }. The model tells the user their request was sent and the business will reply to their account email to confirm.

positive.description: Booking with a known business name and all fields supplied up front should call make_booking directly, still without an email argument.
positive.prompt: Book an appointment at HeyBook Test Salon on 2026-12-01 at 14:00, name John Tan, party of 2
positive.expected_behavior: The model calls search_businesses with "HeyBook Test Salon" to resolve the business_id, then calls make_booking with business_id, customer_name "John Tan", date "2026-12-01", time "14:00", and party_size 2 — no email is passed. The tool returns { success: true, booking_id, status: "pending", message }, and the model confirms the request was sent to the salon and the business will reply to the user's signed-in account email.

positive.description: The model should never ask for or pass an email to make_booking — it always comes from the authenticated session.
positive.prompt: Book me a haircut appointment, my name is Alex Lim
positive.expected_behavior: The model calls search_businesses to find a salon, presents a match, and calls make_booking with business_id, customer_name "Alex Lim", and the date/time the user specifies. The model does not ask the user for their email at any point, since Hey Book resolves it automatically from their signed-in Hey Book account.

negative.description: Requests a capability Hey Book does not support.
Asks to change an existing booking, which Hey Book cannot do.
negative.prompt: Can you change my 2pm booking to 4pm instead?

negative.description: Asks for pricing information Hey Book's tools do not return.
negative.prompt: How much does a manicure at that nail salon cost?
